rule: Light Path is permanent, asked for, planned, gated on one commit, and wave delegations stay safe
description: P3 coupling inside plugin/agents/overlord.md. The source pin carries the Light Path's standing claim: it is permanent and never a fallback, so rewording it into a degraded or temporary path is loud. Three consumer pins carry the path-choice rule for a standard-delivery request that names neither path, one per clause: the discriminating condition (names neither the engine nor the Light Path), the exemption (a request carrying a working_branch.base ref takes the engine without asking, which keeps an unattended overlord from stalling on a question), and the obligation (otherwise ask the user which to use). Four consumer pins carry the Light Path's run obligations, each on its key terms: a plan before any edit, from cerebrate or supplied by the user; the PR opened only on a commit that validation and local review both passed on, condition and obligation in one pattern; a commit made after a gate passed reruns that gate; and anything else decided per Stop Conditions. Three consumer pins carry the Parallel Delegation Safety section: its heading together with its opening sentence, so a heading rename is loud even though the section is also cited by name elsewhere in the file, and the two must-forbid rules (git writes, repo-global mutations), each pinned on its subject and its obligation. Honest residual: pins claim word sequences only, never meaning. A rewrite elsewhere in the file that contradicts a pinned clause stays green, and a citation of the section from another file is not checked. Not pinned: the Engine sentence and the Tier A bullet that cite the path-choice rule, the local-review skip exemption, the working-branch, delegation, molt and post-PR watch obligations of the Light Path, and the sentence that sends run-ledger writes to the final report.

source.pattern: permanent delivery path beside the script engine, never a fallback

consumers.pattern: selects `standard-delivery` and the request names neither the engine nor the Light Path
take the engine if the request carries a `working_branch.base` ref
otherwise ask the user which to use
a plan before any edit, from `hivemind:cerebrate` or supplied by the user
only on a commit that validation per `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/definitions.md` (Validation Procedure) and local review both passed on
A commit made after a gate passed reruns that gate
Decide anything else, such as order, failures and questions, per `### Stop Conditions`

## Parallel Delegation Safety

These rules hold for every wave of parallel delegations
Each wave delegation must forbid git writes
Each wave delegation must forbid repo-global mutations
